profile.summary: Cordoba Corporation is a California firm that provides program management, construction management and planning services for public infrastructure, including transportation, water, energy and school facilities. It was founded in 1983 and has offices across California, including San Francisco.

sources.title: An Award-Winning Year for Cordoba Corporation's Education and Facilities Sector
